full.description_html:
Capidel Consulting Inc. is a Toronto-based strategy and finance partner to founders and growing businesses. We combine business strategy with finance, delivered by one team working from one set of numbers, so owners can see what is actually driving profitability, cash flow and enterprise value.

Services include fractional CFO support, financial modelling, budgeting and forecasting, and exit planning.
